name: IMC Krems University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Krems on the Danube: eight full-time English bachelor's in business, wine, tourism, informatics, chemistry and biotech.

ib.text: The ministry says an IB Diploma needs no equivalence check; IMC says it checks foreign certificates after you apply and may set extra exams. English is judged at your interview; no certificate needed.

dates.label: Applications for the 2027/28 study year open

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Business administration, economics and management with a specialisation in corporate finance or entrepreneurship and innovation, a 22-week internship semester and an optional dual degree with KEDGE Bordeaux.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: International Business Management
programmes.about: International business administration and economics for working with partners around the world, taught entirely in English with a further foreign language on top.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: International Wine Business
programmes.about: Business administration combined with viticulture and oenology in the Krems wine region, for managing in the wine and beverage trade; a 22-week internship in semester 5 is the centrepiece.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

separateFrom.name: International Business Management
separateFrom.reason: A different subject: the wine business, where International Business Management is general international management; each has its own page and application.

programmes.name: StartUp Management
programmes.about: How start-ups are planned, founded, led and scaled, from first concept to growing company, combining management theory with practical work on innovative ideas.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: Tourism and Leisure Management
programmes.about: Business administration applied to tourism and leisure: designing tourism products, marketing destinations and staging events, with German or Spanish alongside English and a 22-week internship abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.about: Inorganic, analytical, organic and physical chemistry and biochemistry, with a heavy share of lab work in small groups and a choice of instrumental analysis or organic and pharmaceutical chemistry.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation letter and a short essay in the online application, then an interview in English that discusses them; the strongest get a place. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: Informatics
programmes.about: Software development, data science and machine learning: how information is processed and turned into useful services, for careers such as developer, data scientist or AI engineer.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

programmes.name: Medical and Pharmaceutical Biotechnology
programmes.about: Cell and molecular biology, genetic engineering and biochemistry with extensive lab practicals, plus how biopharmaceutical production processes and plants are designed.
programmes.selectionNote: A motivation statement in the online application, then an interview in English (online or in Krems); the strongest get a place, others wait. Apply from 1 Dec 2026.

notes: Selection is by a written motivation statement and a one-to-one interview; strong candidates get a place straight away, others go on a waiting list.

The 2027 closing date is not yet published; for 2026 entry the regular deadline was 15 April 2026 for EU and non-EU alike, and IMC may then extend selected programmes for EU citizens if places remain.
The health degrees (physiotherapy, nursing, midwifery and others) are taught in German.
